user.title: Add RetroTINK Device
user.description: Add a RetroTINK-4K connected by USB serial or RFC2217 serial over IP. You can add multiple devices by running this setup again.

data.serial_port: Serial port or RFC2217 URL (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0 or rfc2217://192.168.1.95:4000)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the serial path or RFC2217 URL, permissions, and network availability.

abort.already_configured: This serial connection is already configured
